# Regional Ore Distribution & Cave Ecosystems

![GeoCaves. Ore, geode and caves update](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fcafdce6fe138e2aa0645deedc667c0d092c43f7_0.webp)

GeoCaves is a vanilla Minecraft datapack that completely rewrites underground ore generation, adds biome‑specific cave vegetation, decorative stone layers, custom geodes, and TNT veins. Now every biome group has its own set of ores, cave plants, and hidden surprises – making mining a regional adventure.

---

## Regional Ores

## Compass – Always Know What to Mine

When holding a **compass** in either hand, an actionbar message appears showing the ores available in your current region. It updates once per second (20 ticks) to reduce performance impact.

![Compass display](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8fb3bc7b4d2d44eb31b30ce9e3ef28a17217399f_0.webp)

There is also a convenient advancement system that tells you which ores belong to which region. To unlock an entry, simply visit the region and go underground.

---

## New Geodes!

Amethyst geodes are now exclusive to the Magical region. In their place, we’ve added several new geodes with unique contents – and they appear not only in the Overworld, but also in the Nether and the End!

| Geode Type | Where to Find | Special Contents |
|------------|---------------|------------------|
| **Diamond** | Mountain & Snowy biomes | Diamond ore, air‑filled |
| **Emerald** | Calm biomes | Emerald ore, slime blocks, froglight |
| **Lapis** | Aquatic biomes | Lapis ore, prismarine, sea lanterns |
| **Amethyst** | Magical biomes | Amethyst blocks, calcite, buds (tiny & giant variants) |
| **End** | Small End Islands | Raw iron/gold/copper blocks |
| **Nether Quartz** | Nether Wastes | Quartz ore, glowstone |
| **Nether Diamond** | Basalt Deltas | Deepslate diamond ore, filled with lava |

![End Geodes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c4a6866407460e0c267d594a8afb5b0f3c768e29.jpeg)

## ⚠️ Compatibility & Limitations

### ❌ Incompatibility with some other datapacks

GeoCaves completely overrides **every** vanilla overworld biome, as well as basalt deltas, nether wastes, and small end islands. This means it is **incompatible** with any other datapack that modifies biome JSON files (e.g., global ore rebalancing, world generation overhauls, etc.). Only one such datapack can be active at a time.

### ❌ Modded biomes

GeoCaves **does not affect** biomes added by mods or other datapacks. Those biomes will retain vanilla ore distribution, which breaks the regional balance.
